unit.why: A single narrative: a learned mitnaged from Brisk visits the tsaddik of Medzhybizh on Shabbat, witnesses his self-reproach and repentance, and recognizes him as a man of God.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי שהיה מתנגד אחד גדול בתורה בבריסק
stories.end_quote: וראה המתנגד איך שאיש אלהים הוא
stories.summary_en: A learned mitnaged from Brisk, in Medzhybizh for a wedding, visits the local tsaddik on Shabbat. The tsaddik raises a hard question on a midrash, cannot answer it, and repents for forgetting to pray for those who paid him. Wisdom then opens to him, he gives a wonderful explanation, and the mitnaged sees that he is a man of God.
